properties.name: ML-KEM-512 (Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k^2 * n log n) polynomial ring operations, n=256, k=2

properties.name: Barrett Modular Reduction over Z_3329
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(1) per coefficient, 2 multiplications + 1 shift + 1 subtraction; Space: O(1)
properties.algorithm_variant: Vectorized Barrett modular reduction for 16-bit signed SIMD integers

properties.name: RISC-V Vector Extension v1.0 (RVV 1.0)
properties.throughput_bounds: Vector Length Agnostic (VLEN >= 128 bits), LMUL configuration for high throughput
properties.register_dependency: Vector registers (v0-v31), vtype and vl CSR registers

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Signed high-half 16-bit integer multiplication of vector registers vs2 and vs1, result written to vd
Multiply elements in vs1 and vs2 and accumulate into vd for vector modular reduction inner loops

properties.volatile_status: v0-v31 caller-saved under standard RISC-V V ABI

properties.operation: Normalizes polynomial coefficients after matrix-vector NTT multiplications

properties.vector_width: 16x 16-bit polynomial coefficients processed simultaneously per 256-bit VLEN vector lane

properties.stage: High 16-bit multiplication stage computing floor(a * v / 2^26) estimate in Barrett reduction
Correction product subtraction via negative constant vector accumulation

properties.access_pattern: Read operands from vs1/vs2 vector registers and write high-half product to vd
Read/Write target vector register vd during fused multiply-accumulate vector pass

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 203: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM-512)
RISC-V Vector Extension Instruction Set Specification Version 1.0
